static_traits.name: 方林
static_traits.social_status: Fairly close with friends, but hesitates to share own cooking results for fear of being evaluated
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past或咨询；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高、语气平和；能进行理性Reflection与证据检视；主观报告Anxiety present与反复怀疑

basic_info.main_problem: I have been worrying about how friends will view the Italian food I cook, even though I myself greatly enjoy cooking.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这些持续的怀疑正在影响我对烹饪的享受并造成not必要的压力，这促使我寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: 我的好坏取决于他人的评价

special_situations.event: The situation of cooking Italian food for friends and about to serve it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果朋友not喜欢我的菜，就说明我not是好Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Worries repeatedly before serving and pursues perfection to avoid negative evaluation, or shares less with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得not好、他们会失望

special_situations.event: Thinks about sharing his own Italian food at social occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的评价决定我的好坏
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在分享前not断揣测朋友的看法，尝试用自我安慰压制担忧但效果not佳
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们可能觉得我not行、他们会看not起我的厨艺

special_situations.event: Recalls friends' past praise and positive feedback about one's cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not足以证明能力，必须持续Gaining recognition才算合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或弱化正面证据，继续纠结潜在负评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些赞美not算数、他们只是客气

special_situations.event: Graduate student最后一年Academic pressure增大、临近与朋友聚餐
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在压力下若表现not佳，就会被朋友评价为not好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises standards, blames oneself harshly, reduces proactively inviting friends to taste
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might mess up; they will be disappointed

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被朋友认可、被接纳，享受Freedom分享与被赞赏的体验
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate和被评判，担心被看到“not够好”而感到羞耻
defense_goal: 通过谨慎与证据检视来降低被negate的风险，减少暴露以保持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: Anxiety的取悦者（担心not够好、需要他人认可）
object_relations.object_representation: 评判性的他人（可能失望或negate的朋友）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about how friends might evaluate her cooking, or when asked in counseling to examine evidence and automatic thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为只有充分证据才能避免他人的negate，否则朋友就会not喜欢自己的菜（将他人视为随时可能评判的对象）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use客观、中性语气，列举支持与反证、讨论概率与事实，尽量减少情绪化词语与自我评价。

manifestations: 在烹饪与分享时受他人评价束缚，难以Freedom地按自身喜好行动
Shifts attention from self-experience to external approval, hesitates to share
outcomes: 对烹饪的享受显著下降

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others，与“拥有”对应，语言表现为：‘他在看not起我’，‘他们想排挤我’等。
manifestations: 反复猜测朋友会not喜欢自己的菜
在尚not yet得到真实反馈前就预设他人负面评价

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-scrutinizes and berates herself before sharing, pursuing perfection to avoid bad reviews
Invites friends to taste less often for fear of judgment

positive_force: Has stable interest in and enjoyment of cooking itself
Has previously received positive feedback from friends (compliments, requests for recipes)
Has the willingness to rationally examine evidence and adjust expectations (positive attitude)
Has a friend group to rely on (social support available)
negative_force: Excessively concerned with others' evaluations, seeking external validation
自动化思维频繁（读心术、预测not yet来、negate正面）
Academic pressure溢出到生活其他领域，增加Anxiety水平
Avoidance and hesitation arise from worry about being judged; reduces sharing

target_behavior.behavior: 在为朋友烹饪或想到分享时出现Significant anxiety与回避（犹豫、减少邀请）
antecedent: Cooking Italian food for friends and preparing to serve it
想到在社交场合分享菜品
target_behavior.core_reason: 过度关注外部评价与潜在negate，自动化思维（读心术、预测not yet来、negate正面）在压力背景下被激活，导致自我价值与表现过度绑定他人看法
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与可能的羞耻感，以降低即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 对烹饪的乐趣被削弱；与朋友互动与分享减少；注意力与生产力下降，日常Increased stress
